message.content:
The value of $20 in British pounds varies with the current exchange rate.  
As a rough estimate—using a recent average rate of about 1 USD ≈ 0.78 GBP—$20 would be around **£15.60**.  

For an accurate, up‑to‑date conversion, check a trusted financial news site, your bank’s website, or a currency‑conversion app.
